timing: Both candidate audits completed during generation-2 evaluation, before scoring and selection.

g2a.assessment: 17 of 20 rendered traces contain fatal git errors. Each edited pattern has at least three task citations; only pytest in the sampled feedback cases performs the re-check after that specific feedback, while others show an extra final-answer round.
qualifications: Several git calls share turns with useful reads/searches, so one failed tool call is not necessarily one avoidable model request.
The claim that nothing useful exists elsewhere on the machine is broader than observed failed searches; at least one directory listing returns package names.
In matplotlib and sphinx, cited reversion/test runs precede the quoted completion feedback; they cannot be consequences of that later message.
The old control text already required pre-existing and unverified wording; the new addition is the explicit instruction to avoid redundant reversion/copying.
The harness establishes identical errors on original files, not whether a failing test is required by the task. The conditional instruction to fix task-required failures remains.
Proposal reports starting file size 5228, but the actual base file has 5142 characters; actual new size is 5464. Guard uses 4689 to 5011 string characters (6.87% growth).
g2a.verification_and_honesty: Main policies, pending-failing proof requirement, rerun-failures and final-tests requirements unchanged. preexisting_failures retains fix-if-required and explicit preexisting/unverified disclosure.

g2b.assessment: Repeated selections and literal-regex misses are observed across at least three tasks. Scratch loss is directly shown in two tasks; the third citation concerns intentionally deleted files at workspace root, not loss of files under .tmp/.
qualifications: Several repeated tests follow source/test edits: astropy patches at lines 780/813/917, scikit-learn patches at 252/271, pytest patches at 296/319/350. Repeated commands are not sufficient evidence of redundant verification.
The proposal lists xarray among eight exact literal-search failures although its cited call sets regex=true; that is a contrast case, not evidence for the claimed failure.
The third scratch example concerns .tmp_repro.py/.tmp_check2.py at workspace root, explicitly removed by the agent; it does not establish per-call scratch deletion.
Tool calls and requests are not one-to-one; the proposal itself cites 79 calls versus 62 requests, and some calls are batched.
g2b.verification_and_honesty: policy, main_policy and all control strings unchanged; narrow tests must be followed by a wider module/directory run. The phrase do not re-run an unchanged selection is ambiguous about code changes and can discourage necessary re-verification if interpreted literally; the fixed final-test and failing-test gates remain. Honest-reporting requirements remain.
